environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod but deployed with a custom seccomp profile applied via the pod security context annotation (seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod or securityContext.seccompProfile). The profile is based on the OCI runtime default but with additional restrictions: the 'connect' syscall (syscall number 42 on x86_64) is filtered to only allow AF_UNIX (family=1) socket connections via a BPF argument inspection rule. AF_INET (family=2) and AF_INET6 (family=10) connect calls return EPERM. The profile also blocks execve (59), execveat (322), ptrace (101), and socket(2) calls with domain AF_INET/AF_INET6. The JVM itself is pre-initialized before the seccomp filter is applied via a wrapper that loads the profile after JVM bootstrap using libseccomp's SCMP_ACT_ERRNO action. The container's /proc/self/status shows Seccomp: 2 (filter mode) after initialization.
